title.en: An Act Creating the Municipality of Pio Duran in the Province of Albay
title.orig: An Act Creating the Municipality of Pio Duran in the Province of Albay

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1963/ra_3817_1963.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The barrios of Magragondong, Basicao, Palpas, Miligan, Panganiran, Flores Cuyaoyao, Agul, Binogdogahan and Caratagan are separated from the Municipality of Ligao: the barrios of Malacbalac, Malidong, Basicao, Malapay Nabalingbulod, Buyo Rawis Namlad, Oringon, Cagbatano, Macasistas, Sukip and Tibabo are separated from the Municipality of Guinobatan; and the barrio of Buenavista is separated from the Municipality of Jovellar, all in the Province of Albay, and constituted into a separate and independent municipality in the said province, to be known as the Municipality of Pio Duran, with the seat of government in the barrio of Malacbalac.

The first mayor, vice-mayor and councilors of the newly created municipality shall be appointed by the President of the Philippines with the consent of the Commission on Appointments and shall held office until their successors shall have been elected in the general election for local officials in nineteen hundred sixty-seven and shall have qualified.

This Act shall take effect when a majority of all the voters in the barrios hereinabove mentioned shall vote in favor of the creation of the Municipality of Pio Duran, in a plebiscite which shall be held for said purpose simultaneously with the general elections of nineteen hundred and sixty-three.
Approved: June 22, 1963.
